gameData.backstory: Bartholomew 'Barty' Rottingham carved out a niche for himself among the Street Runners, not for his speed but for his grit. After a run gone wrong left him exposed to toxic runoff, the rot set in, but Barty didn't let it slow him down – it just made him smell worse and gave him a fetching greenish hue. Now, wielding scavenged golf club, he leads raids, seeking DRIP and revenge on the goons who left him for dead.
gameData.name: Barty "Rotten" Rottingham
gameData.personality: Grumpy and cynical, survival in Subchain City has hardened Barty and he's become fiercely protective of his flock. He possesses a twisted sense of humor, often cracking dark jokes even in the direst situations. Despite his rough exterior, Barty harbors a longing for the days before the fall, sometimes wistfully reminiscing about a time when water wasn't radioactive.

specialAbility.description: Barty's toxic rot grants him immunity to most environmental hazards and a passive poison aura. In close combat, his attacks have a chance to inflict 'Toxic Buildup,' damaging enemies over time. Higher levels of Toxic Buildup can cause enemies to convulse.
specialAbility.name: Toxic Touch
